content.text: Leann Rimes goes viral for video of tension release in her jaw. Rimes has opened up about dealing with mental health from young fame. Garry Lineham explains “the jaw is one of the body’s primary storage sites for stress. By using the maneuvers to signal safety to the nervous system, we can finally allow that stored energy to move.”🎥: @garrylinehamI don’t trust it. Next thing we will hear how she had her jaw permanently damaged from this.I have had this done and it cured my TMJ. I never had an emotional release but that does happen to me when I'm getting a massage sometimes. We hold a lot of emotions in our bodies. I think this video is very beautiful and brave. Glad she sharedNothing is "released" during this. When a severely painful stimulus stops, it is very relieving. She's only tolerating it because she has been convinced it is helpful.I felt the emotion of that releaseIt’s called a SER and it’s real. As someone very science based and anatomy based, our muscles have proved to hold tension even after we die and our bowels and other muscles release. Tension points/trigger points that linger. Literally created during a time of great stress. Release and release that emotion immediately. Some break down and cry. Some laugh profusely. Some get angry and curse. It’s a somatic emotional release.If you’re commenting something negative about how she goes about healing herself and releasing built up trauma and hurt. Then I assume you’ve never experienced much pain, and emotional trauma. This is no different than someone seeking counseling, talking with a counselor, taking medicine etc. there are many ways to heal. This is just one way that many people don’t discuss or use. And I’m glad I found this. ❤️
